review_kind: Independent native Codex read-only source and runtime review; no merge authorization
verdict: PASS within journal/storage scope on real assembled dependency; no remaining confirmed defect found

repaired_during_review.issue: Historical event pages/exact retries did not recompute the signed event hash against loaded event body bytes.
repaired_during_review.discovery: Author/root reported; reviewer independently inspected the final fix.
repaired_during_review.fix: rowValue recomputes hash(event minus hash), then verifies the receipt signature and all event/request/index/receipt bindings.
repaired_during_review.regression: cached history pages and retries rebind event bytes to their signed receipt hash

source_checks: Signed events bind complete immutable genesis, current state hash, previous event head, scope, command/principal, draws/effects and deterministic after-state. Signed receipts use the fixed domain separator and independent pinned public trust.
Whole replay rejects repeated request IDs; single-event verification correctly documents that history-wide uniqueness needs an external index.

SQLite event, receipt and unique request identity reside in one row inserted under BEGIN IMMEDIATE; cache publication occurs only after COMMIT. Exceptions roll back and do not publish speculative state.
Each read/write transaction verifies metadata and cached head, then catches up new committed events before using state. Read pagination occurs in the same read transaction.
Worker owns synchronous SQLite and signature/replay operations. Parent RPC is asynchronous, clones DTOs before posting, bounds outstanding calls and drains accepted calls before close.
Worker failure rejects pending calls with explicit may-have-committed uncertainty; exact request retries are checked before current cursor admission and bound to full command plus principal.

New database files are created0600, regular-file check rejects direct symlinks, extensions/trusted schema disabled, WAL/FULL synchronous used. Parent/worker key matches genesis and private PEM is not persisted in database or returned.
Incremental caches and host-only state/history/receipt APIs have explicit privileged-DB and disclosure limits; no unverified scope-to-filesystem or player-facing authentication claim.

independent_sigkill_trials.limit: No sampled trial landed between durable commit and receipt acknowledgment; no power-loss guarantee.

limits: Existing file/directory permissions and authenticated principal delivery are host responsibilities.

Incremental snapshots trust previously verified database rows to stay append-only; historical body tamper on selected pages/retries is checked, but a privileged editor can require full reopen to detect all historical edits.
External expectedHead is required to detect rollback across restarts; it authenticates a supplied prefix, not an unknowable newer head.
No call cancellation or hard end-to-end timeout; five-second SQLite busy timeout and128 pending requests are not proof against a stuck kernel/filesystem.
SIGKILL probes tested process crashes, not host power loss or arbitrary filesystem corruption.
Review of these five files is not proof of core rule correctness, actor-view disclosure correctness, production isolation or independent trust-root approval.

Ten process-kill trials cover precommit and acknowledged-commit recovery; none observed a durable unacknowledged commit. The atomic SQLite transaction and exact-retry index are source-reviewed, not a proof over every crash point.
concurrent_root_work: Root advanced only unrelated integration-test/balance capture files during review; source/contracts/fixtures and both reviewed test files remained identical to the tested assembled commit.

runtime_dependency.implementation: Real RP200 core; no shadow rules
